title: 車站車窗
teacherNotes: Teacher-approved final source for L153. Latest origin/main is L147, so this package depends on unmerged L148 時, L149 還, L150 燈, L151 關, and L152 窗; do not merge production JSON until L148-L152 are present in latest origin/main. Use Taiwan Traditional Chinese and Taiwan zhuyin only; use 為 not 爲 and 裡 not 裏. Do not add unlearned display characters such as 電, 動, 停, 牌, 排, 等, 司, 機. Images must use L058 style anchors and contain no text, numbers, signs, route numbers, station names, license plates, zhuyin, labels, English, logos, or watermarks. Audio must be standalone OpenAI charAudio, whole-sentence AI audio, independent G02 prefix/suffix, and independent G05 wrong-choice whole-sentence audio.
